notes.title: Online Update 1 for Overcooked! 2 Crossplay Branch
notes.content:
Attention, Chefs! 

We are aware of the current issues affecting your gameplay experience, and so we are releasing this patch to allow us to gather some important data that will help us investigate any pressing issues in Overcooked! 2. This will be for the crossplay branch only. 

The development and QA team have spent a considerable amount of time over the last few months trying to replicate and identify the online issues reported by the community, and it's one of our highest priorities to address these so we can provide a stable online experience for our players. However, due to the complexity of online networking, it has been difficult for us to narrow down the specific causes of multiplayer issues. This patch will be valuable in helping us to provide the missing information we need so an effective fix can be made, as well as confirm any fixes we make are successful.  

The analytics we will be tracking: 


 User Location (region) 
 Platform played on. 
 Has the user succeeded/failed logging into T17OS. 
 Has the user succeeded/failed platform Privilege check. 
 Detailed information about the Gamelift session including creating/joining/leaving/Session Length and general fail information. (Gamelift is a service provided by Amazon that we use for hosting online sessions) 
 Detailed information about the T17OS session including creating/joining/leaving/Session Length and general fail information. 
 Detailed information about the Platform session including creating/joining/leaving/Session Length and general fail information. 
 Information about the P2P connection including number of fails and why it is failing. 
 NAT type information.  


Will I be able to opt out of this patch?
By accepting the EULA when you first reach the main menu, you will be opted into having analytics data collected. However, you may opt out at any point by going to “Settings> Game Settings > Analytics Reporting" and unchecking the tick box. 

As always, if you encounter any problems with the game, please email our support team: help@team17support.com

notes.title: New public_test branch available!
notes.content:
Hi Chefs!
 
If you've been struggling to matchmake when playing on Steam, we've set up a test branch for you to try out.
 
The 'public_test' branch should give you an improved online experience. We'll be running the test with this branch until October 18th, collecting player feedback along the way.

Please note: At present, this will not allow crossplay with Epic Games.
 
This is a really valuable test for us, as it allows us to get as many players as possible online to play and matchmake so that we can them implement a patch to the game to fix this issue for everyone!

Collecting your feedback from this test branch is vital for us so we can look into fixing the matchmaking issue.

notes.title: Overcooked! 2 Feedback Survey - Have your say!
notes.content:
Hey there chefs!

Kevin is looking for some food .... And by food we mean, feedback for Overcooked! 2.

We're continuously improving Overcooked! 2 and would appreciate your feedback in our player survey. This gives you the opportunity to have your say on the future of Overcooked!

As part of the survey process, we like to reward survey participants with Team17 loot. At the end of the survey, there will be an option for you to enter a prize draw where you can be in with a chance to win one of three Team17 merch items!

To take part in the survey, just click HERE! 


FAQs

What's the deadline to give you my feedback?
The deadline to complete the survey is Tuesday, 2nd October at 17.00 BST.
What type of questions are asked?

The main survey questions consist of 'Choose one option', or 'Tick all that apply' -type questions.
Each of the above types has an accompanying optional comment box.

Optional comment boxes
Feel free to leave more feedback, or not. It's entirely up to you, but if there's something about the game you feel strongly about (positive or otherwise) you can use a comment box to tell us more. Otherwise, feel free to skip them.

Do you read the feedback we leave in the comment boxes?
We sure do! If you do decide to complete a comment box, be assured that we read every single comment. You have spent the time writing out your feedback, we will spend the time reading it, and taking notes.

What happens to the survey feedback I'm providing?
All data is stored and analysed on the Team17 Usability PCs. Data analyses will be passed on to the development team, and potentially used for game play improvements/changes. All your data remains anonymous, so if you decide to leave your email address for the prize draw, then this personal data is not passed on with the analyses. You can read the Team17 Privacy Policy HERE.

How long does the survey take to complete?
There are 32 questions in total. Most of them require you to check a box or boxes, with the rest of them being optional comment boxes. We're trying to be thorough by asking so many questions, but we also appreciate we might be taking up your precious time. Any help at all is appreciated.

I have more questions/the survey borked on me!
If you have any other questions or concerns about the survey, or the survey breaks/doesn't behave, please email and let us know - usability@team17.com

Thank you! We really appreciate you taking the time to complete our survey!

Best,
Team17

notes.title: On The Menu: Update Incoming!
notes.content:
Hello Chefs!

We’re aiming to put out an update next week that will address some of the issues players have encountered, including a softlock crash and a bug which has caused the chef unlocks to only happen for the host of an online game. Fixing this softlock issue should also help with the players that have been having online disconnection issues as we believe this is linked to hosts experiencing softlocks.

We’ve also been tracking feedback about two issues:

Key rebinds: We’re seeing the demand loud and clear for the ability to change key bindings and we’ve begun work on implementing this into the game. It’s not going to happen immediately but it’s one of our top priorities and we’ll let you know when you can expect to see it in the game.

Player progress for campaign co-op: Due to the way save games currently work with each of the players joining a host, only the host of the online session retains progress so we’re looking into a redesign of the current system. Our aim is to make it so that all players will be able to share progress when playing as a group online. We’re already investigating the best route forward and will update the community as to when we expect to be able to integrate this into the game.

If you experience any other issues, please continue to post in the Report A Problem forum.

Thanks!
